title: Normalized International Morse code printable symbol registry
description: A machine-readable transcription of printable Morse assignments used to test threshold-derived patterns without inventing a private codebook.
rights_statement: The local JSON is a normalized factual transcription of code assignments and does not reproduce the recommendation's prose, layout, or publication file. Rights in the ITU source publication remain with the International Telecommunication Union.

artifacts.description: Printable letters, figures, punctuation marks, and miscellaneous written signs from ITU-R M.1677-1 sections 1.1.1 through 1.1.3.

sources.creator: International Telecommunication Union Radiocommunication Sector
sources.title: Recommendation ITU-R M.1677-1: International Morse code
sources.role: Authoritative reference for International Morse code character assignments and signal timing.
